messages.subject: merging box plots
parts:
Hello,

I want to dodge boxplots on one graph, each from a different stacked
data frame. Color separation between the dodged plots would be nice as
well.
#Reproducible data frames

typ_groups=data.frame(ind=rep(letters[1:6],10),values=rnorm(60,mean=10))

guide_groups=data.frame(ind=rep(letters[1:6],10),values=rnorm(60,mean=15))

#Easy to graph the first

typ=ggplot(typ_groups, aes(factor(ind),values))
typ + geom_boxplot()+coord_flip()

#Not easy to add the second

typ + geom_boxplot(data=guide_groups)


any assistance is greatly appreciated,

Josh


--
Josh Katz
Doctoral Candidate
Nutritional Biology
Graduate Group
UC Davis

messages.author: 223beb57ce203bde
messages.subject: Re: merging box plots
parts:
Is this what you want?

df <- rbind(typ_groups, guide_groups)
df$g <- rep(c('typ', 'guide'), each=60)
qplot(factor(ind), values, data=df, geom='boxplot', fill=g)

Xie Chao
